scope: Current Agent and manual-save core acceptance; native acceptance is recorded separately

cases.check: Conversations and drafts do not automatically become facts; explicit saving preserves selected text and provenance.
Manual saving appends exactly once without another organization job; undo preserves the original text.
A version conflict does not overwrite the target or create an extra memory or source archive.
If any grouped undo conflicts, none of the changes are applied.
The version read remains separate from the newly written version; citations still open the original evidence.
Sources and grouped undo remain available after conversation deletion.
Cancellation preserves visible text and prevents subsequent writes.
Concurrent writes are deduplicated and only one competing version update succeeds.
